visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a POV night drive on a highway, with white lane markings and glowing streetlights rushing past under a dark sky. The car dashboard is slightly visible at the bottom. (2) The scene cuts to the Presidential Office Building in Taipei, brightly illuminated by spotlights against the night sky; a yellow taxi cruises along the wide street in front of the historic architecture. (3) A group of people, including a man in a black cap and children, are walking through a large, empty urban plaza at night, with bright stadium-style lighting in the background and white event tents. (4) Transition to a crowded dawn scene with hundreds of participants wearing orange event shirts gathered in front of large blue banners and brightly lit stages. (5) The main characters, a man and several women/children, are seen getting ready, putting on elaborate black and gold 'witch hunter' style costumes with ornate capes and headpieces. (6) At the starting line, the crowd of runners in orange shirts is dense; the man and a woman in costume count down with their fingers raised and then cheer as they begin to jog. (7) Scenes of the characters running through city streets lined with palm trees and modern high-rise buildings as the morning light becomes clearer. (8) The characters cross a 3K finish line marked by a large inflatable arch; they finally pose for a selfie while holding up a circular blue and white commemorative medal.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the muffled hum of a car engine and rolling tires on a road, accompanied by a male narrator's voice which is clear and calm. He speaks with moderate pacing and a friendly, storytelling tone. (2) An upbeat, high-tempo electronic pop track fades in, featuring a driving synthesized bassline and a steady percussive beat. The narrator's voice rises in pitch and energy, showing higher arousal as he describes arriving at the location. (3) A distinct transition 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies a change in scene; background sounds now include the light chatter of a gathering crowd and the distant sound of loudspeakers. (4) The music swells in volume with more complex layers, including a female vocal hook in English. A collective '3-2-1' countdown is heard from multiple voices, followed by a burst of cheering and the rhythmic sound of many footsteps on pavement. (5) As the running sequence progresses, the sound of wind rushing past the microphone is audible, mixed with rhythmic breathing and the sharp clink of a metallic object. The female voice speaks with a slightly breathless but cheerful tone. (6) The video concludes with the sounds of a celebratory crowd at a finish line, with a melodic 'ding' sound effect appearing as a medal is shown, while the music resolves into a final upbeat chorus.
